title: Cobblemon Stone Statues
description: Adds stone statues of every pokemon model that you have in any position (including fakemon, megas, etc) with sizes from 0.5x to 3x
body:
![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc33f0ebe4f7b612c26f0096414d8870c6c8d5de_0.webp)

![Statues made with the mod in different positions and sizes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db208587f509c6da540530e0d420f78c26b1e35d.png)

## 📘 About the mod

**Cobblemon Stone Statues adds Statue blocks to Cobblemon, it grabs every pokemon you have in your modpack, including fakemon and alternative versions, like Megas, Hisuian forms, etc. It than grabs those models and gives them a stone like texture, and allows you to select any animation you have in your files for that pokemon so he is positioned like in the animation, and lets you choose what size the statue should be, with the options of 0.5x, 1x, 2x and 3x. These statues only have a 1 block hitbox regardless of the pokemon size or statue size, this is because, if a player doesnt have that same model you do, and has another one for example, they will see their model as the statue, so instead you should either leave it with just the 1 block hitbox or i'd recommend you use barrier blocks to create a "fake" hitbox, so players can't move through the statue.**

**To create a statue you need a Statue Chisel, which you can easily craft with planks and an iron ingot, than all you need is 5 stones if you're in survival to start placing Statues, and you also have the capability of rotating the statue 45º, allowing you to have diagonal facing statues.**

**The mod is required both on server and client.**

## 💡 Dependencies:

**You only need Cobblemon to play this mod!**
